title: A role under `chan` that is not a real role still passes, so a misspelled role does nothing and nobody is told
plain: If someone misspells a role name in a block list, the check stays green and the report shows a block for a role that does not exist. The real role stays uncovered without anyone being warned.
can_cu: The effect is mild: it only happens when a person mistypes the owner's own data file, nothing is lost, and the report is easy to correct by hand once someone notices.

title: Role names under `chan` are never checked, so a `chan` entry that does nothing still passes
plain: A block entry that does nothing, such as a typo or a role that can already view, still passes and can make a role look blocked when it is not. The report may then mislead the owner.
can_cu: No user data is at risk and the owner can fix a wrong entry by hand, but the report may mislead until then, so it is worth recording as a known limit.

title: Hình dạng 5 — tuyên quét LỚP nhưng chỉ có điểm-case: luật mới «chan ở bất kỳ chỗ nào khác ngoài ô xem có thao tác thì đỏ» chỉ được đo ở 2 vị trí
plain: The rule that rejects a block list in the wrong place is tested at only two positions. If a later edit breaks it in the other places, the test suite would not notice.
can_cu: This causes no harm to users today and the rule works now; the risk is only a silent regression later, and adding the missing tests is cheap whenever someone touches this check.
